name: Osttiroler Bergfest & Alpine Blessing
beschreibung: The traditional mountain mass is celebrated on an idyllic alpine meadow overlooking the panoramic vistas of the Hohe Tauern. Brass bands, vocalists, and the blessed scenery make this open-air service an emotionally moving experience. Following the service, guests enjoy an agape with regional farm products.
kurzbeschreibung: Traditional mountain mass in the Hohe Tauern National Park featuring pasture blessing and musical accompaniment.
